questions: Should the function handle non-integer or non-string data types (e.g., floats, booleans, objects) in the array, and if so, how should the histogram bins and labels be generated for them?

Should the histogram include any styling properties (e.g., title, axis labels, grid) beyond the basic bins and ticks shown in the reference?
If the array contains NaN or None values, how should they be handled? Should they be ignored, treated as distinct values, or raise an error?
